description: Resolve all warnings in src/RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol, src/RetroPickBuybackVaultV1.sol, src/RetroPickGraduationExecutorV1.sol, and src/RetroPickGraduationGuardV1.sol. Covers reentrancy-events/no-eth, unsafe-typecast, arbitrary-send-eth, missing-zero-check, and uninitialized-local. Apply per-warning security judgment: fix genuine issues in code, suppress provable false positives with justification.
steps: READ each of the four files fully before editing. Consult .agents/tasks/task-resolve-forge-lint-warnings/warnings_inventory.txt for exact line:col of every warning in these files.

RetroPickGraduationGuardV1.sol line 34 unsafe-typecast (`uint256(uint128(type(int128).max))`): This is an INTENTIONAL, provably-safe bound and the file ALREADY has a detailed comment above it explaining int128 is the real limit. This value provably fits (int128.max >= 0 so uint128 cast is exact, and widening to uint256 is lossless). Suppress with:
  `// unsafe-typecast: int128.max is non-negative so uint128/uint256 widening is exact; this is the intended signed liquidity bound (see comment above).`
  `// forge-lint: disable-next-line(unsafe-typecast)` placed on the line(s) that fire (col 48 and 56 - both casts on the same source line; a single disable-next-line above line 34 covers the whole next line).

RetroPickGraduationExecutorV1.sol unsafe-typecast at 113 (x3), 114 (x2), 149 (x2): READ the surrounding code. These are typically casts of amounts to int128/uint128 for Uniswap v4 (BalanceDelta / modifyLiquidity) or sqrtPrice. For each: if the value is provably bounded (e.g. already validated by the GraduationGuard's MAX_SEED_AMOUNT check, or a tick/price within V4 bounds), suppress with a specific justification naming WHY it fits (e.g. 'amount validated <= MAX_SEED_AMOUNT which equals int128.max'). If a cast is genuinely unchecked and could truncate a user-influenced value, prefer OpenZeppelin SafeCast (SafeCast.toInt128/toUint128) or an explicit require bound instead of suppression. Decide per cast; document the reason in the disable comment.

RetroPickGraduationExecutorV1.sol arbitrary-send-eth at line 183: READ the function. This sends ETH (graduation seeding / payout). Confirm the recipient is a trusted/validated address (e.g. the pool manager, locker, or a stored trusted target) and the call is guarded (access control or nonReentrant). If the destination is controlled by protocol config/owner and not arbitrary caller input, suppress with justification naming the guard and trusted recipient. If the recipient is caller-supplied and unguarded, that is a real issue - add validation.

RetroPickGraduationExecutorV1.sol reentrancy-events at lines 198, 200: These flag events emitted after an external interaction. If the function is protected by nonReentrant and/or follows checks-effects-interactions (state updated before the external call), emitting events after the call is safe. Prefer moving event emission BEFORE the external call where it does not change semantics; otherwise suppress with justification that the function is nonReentrant / state already finalized. Apply the same reasoning consistently.
RetroPickBuybackVaultV1.sol reentrancy-events at line 197: same reentrancy-events reasoning - move emit before the external call if trivially possible, else suppress citing the nonReentrant guard.

RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol reentrancy-events at 259, 419, 423, 470, 542, 605, 717, 726, 775 and reentrancy-no-eth at 586, 716: For each, READ the function. Determine whether it is nonReentrant and whether state is fully updated before external calls (checks-effects-interactions). Where an event trivially can be emitted before the external call without changing meaning, do so (real improvement). Where it cannot (event must report post-call results) and the function is nonReentrant, suppress with a justification citing the guard. Do NOT weaken any existing nonReentrant protection.

RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol missing-zero-check at line 170: READ the site (likely a constructor/setter taking an address such as a token, treasury, or executor). Add a zero-address require/revert consistent with the file's error style.

RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol arbitrary-send-eth at line 569: READ the function. Same reasoning as the Executor case - confirm recipient is trusted/validated (creator payout, treasury, buyback vault) and the send is guarded; suppress with justification or add validation if genuinely arbitrary.

RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol uninitialized-local at line 685: READ around line 685 (a `tokensLocked` style local). The nearby code shows a local declared then conditionally assigned with a well-defined default-zero path. If zero is the intended default and every branch handles it, either explicitly initialize the local to 0 at declaration (clearest fix, removes the warning) OR suppress with justification. Prefer explicit `= 0` initialization.
After edits, run `forge build --force` and confirm ZERO warnings reference these four files.
Run `forge test` and confirm bonding-curve / graduation / buyback related suites still pass (especially important since event reordering and casts touch value-handling paths).
acceptance_criteria: No warnings from `forge build --force` reference RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol, RetroPickBuybackVaultV1.sol, RetroPickGraduationExecutorV1.sol, or RetroPickGraduationGuardV1.sol.
Every suppression comment names the SPECIFIC reason the code is safe (guard, provable bound, trusted recipient) - no generic or empty justifications.
Genuine issues (missing zero-check at BondingCurve:170, uninitialized local at 685) are fixed in code, not suppressed.
No existing nonReentrant guard or value-handling behavior is weakened.
forge test passes with no new failures versus the FEAT-001 baseline.
verification: forge build --force 2>&1 | grep -E 'BondingCurveV1|BuybackVaultV1|GraduationExecutorV1|GraduationGuardV1' | grep -c warning returns 0
forge test passes with no regressions vs baseline
findings:
All warnings in the four in-scope files resolved. forge lint on the four files = 0 warnings; `forge build --force` scoped warning count = 0 (remaining 51 build warnings are all in out-of-scope RetroPickMemeHookV1.sol / RetroPickLaunchFactoryV1.sol, deferred to later features). forge test = 45 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped, matching baseline.

PER-WARNING OUTCOMES:

RetroPickGraduationGuardV1.sol
- 34:48 & 34:56 unsafe-typecast (uint256(uint128(type(int128).max))): SUPPRESSED. int128.max is non-negative so the uint128 narrowing and uint256 widening are both exact; intended signed liquidity bound. One disable-next-line above line 34 covers both casts.

RetroPickGraduationExecutorV1.sol
- 113 (x3) & 114 (x2) unsafe-typecast (uint8(Actions.*)): SUPPRESSED. Actions.MINT_POSITION/SETTLE_PAIR/SWEEP are Uniswap v4 library action constants far below uint8's range; uint8 packing is exact. Added a disable-next-line above each of the two abi.encodePacked lines (one disable covers all casts on its line).
- 149 uint160(amount) & uint48(block.timestamp+300) in _approvePermit2: SUPPRESSED, but refactored the multi-line permit2.approve call into two single-line local assignments so each disable-next-line sits directly above its cast (the prior single disable was mis-anchored above the call open paren, not the cast line, which is why the linter still fired). amount is validated <= type(uint128).max by mintFullRangePosition's overflow guard so uint160 is exact; block.timestamp+300 is far below uint48 for centuries.
- 183 arbitrary-send-eth (payable(recipient).call{value:amount}) in _sweepResidualBalance: SUPPRESSED. recipient is either the immutable trusted locker or protocolFeeRecipient forwarded from mintFullRangePosition (onlyFactory); protocol-controlled, never arbitrary caller input.
- 198 & 200 reentrancy-events (GraduationDustSwept / GraduationDustRetained): SUPPRESSED. Both events report `swept` (the result of the transfer above) so they cannot precede that call; the only entry point mintFullRangePosition is onlyFactory and the contract holds no state between txns.

RetroPickBuybackVaultV1.sol
- 197 reentrancy-events (Released): FIXED IN CODE. Moved emit Released before the feeEscrow.creditToken external calls; release() is nonReentrant, state (vestedUnreleased zeroed, totalReleased advanced) and both amounts are already finalized at that point, so the log is honest and no longer post-call.

RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol
- 170 missing-zero-check (pairToken_): SUPPRESSED (DEVIATION from the criteria's assumption that this is a genuine issue). pairToken_ == address(0) is the intentional sentinel for a native-ETH quote asset (isNativeQuote()); adding a zero-address revert would break every native launch and its tests. This is the per-warning security judgment the feature explicitly requests; suppressed with a concrete justification instead of a behavior-breaking 'fix'.
- 259 reentrancy-events (Initialized): SUPPRESSED. initialize is onlyFactory and one-shot (AlreadyInitialized); only prior external calls are view reads (totalSupply/balanceOf) on the factory's freshly-deployed token. (Tried moving the emit up first, but that produced two new missing-events-arithmetic warnings on reservedTokens/trackedTokens writes, so reverted to end-of-function emit + suppression.)
- 419 CurveBuyRefunded & 423 CurveBuy reentrancy-events in buy(): SUPPRESSED. buy() is nonReentrant and all curve state (trackedQuote/trackedTokens/fees) is finalized before the transfers (checks-effects-interactions).
- 470 CurveSell reentrancy-events in sell(): SUPPRESSED. sell() is nonReentrant, state finalized before payout (CEI).
- 542 CurveCompleted reentrancy-events in graduate(): SUPPRESSED. graduate() is onlyFactory (deliberately not nonReentrant); it sets graduated=true and zeroes trackedQuote/trackedTokens before the transfers, so a reentrant call reverts on the flag and finds empty reserves.
- 569 arbitrary-send-eth in _sendQuote: SUPPRESSED. Private helper; every caller (buy/sell/graduate/sweepFees/rescueFees) validates recipient != address(0) and runs under nonReentrant or onlyFactory, updating tracked reserves before payout (CEI).
- 586 (native) & the ERC-20 branch reentrancy-no-eth in _creditQuote: SUPPRESSED on both feeEscrow.credit and feeEscrow.creditToken. Only caller _sweepFees decrements trackedQuote before invoking this helper (CEI); escrow is trusted/immutable; _sweepFees runs under nonReentrant (sweepFees) or the graduated flag (graduate).
- 605 AutoGraduationFailed reentrancy-events in _tryAutoGraduate: SUPPRESSED. Emitted in the catch reporting the failed graduate() call and gasleft() at that point, so it cannot precede the call; only caller buy() is nonReentrant.
- 685 uninitialized-local (tokensLocked): FIXED IN CODE. Changed `uint256 tokensLocked;` to `uint256 tokensLocked = 0;` (explicit zero default).
- 716 reentrancy-no-eth (buybackVault.lock) & 717 BuybackLocked reentrancy-events in _sweepFees: SUPPRESSED. trackedQuote and trackedTokens are decremented before the lock call (CEI); buybackVault is trusted/immutable; _sweepFees runs under nonReentrant/graduated guards.
- 726 FeesSwept reentrancy-events in _sweepFees: SUPPRESSED. All fee amounts and tracked reserves finalized before the credit calls; nonReentrant/graduated guards.
- 775 FeesRescued reentrancy-events in rescueFees: SUPPRESSED. rescueFees is onlyFactory and zeroes every fee bucket and decrements trackedQuote before the payouts (CEI).

No nonReentrant guard or value-handling behavior was weakened. Only real behavioral change is the BuybackVault Released event now emitting before the escrow credits (data-equivalent, state already finalized). Did NOT touch RetroPickLaunchFactoryV1.sol or the hook. Did NOT commit or push per instructions.
